svg.title: The posterior GDA implies along one feature
svg.desc: Two unit-variance Gaussian densities centred at 0 and 2, with five training points from each class along the axis. The posterior probability of class 1, computed point by point by Bayes' rule, is an S-shaped curve crossing one half at x equals 1, midway between the means, when the prior is one half. With a prior of 0.2 the same curve shifts right and crosses one half at about 1.69.
